description: AGSC-08-31: with lint.min_sources set to N greater than 0, a published concept of kind pattern, taxonomy, explainer or principle with fewer than N counted sources is the warning AGSC-E417; a source that is the IRI of an ai-generated item of the Bundle does not count. Derivation with N = 2 over the minimal fixture, whose two concepts handoff and supervisor are patterns with no sources, so each is one warning. Five concepts are added: solid (explainer, two distinct sources) raises nothing; thin (explainer, one source) is one warning; ai-grounded (explainer) has two sources, one of which is the IRI https://minimal.example/concepts/ai-note/ of the ai-generated concept ai-note, so it counts one and is one warning; ai-note and plain-term are of kind term, which is not one of the four kinds, and raise nothing whatever their sources. Four warnings, exit 0. The configuration is the fixture's with lint.min_sources added; with the key absent, or 0, nothing is checked and the fixture's own lint is empty.
